rules.accepted_credit_types: Nursing CE approved by an ANCC-accredited credentialing agency (course types per N.J.A.C. 13:37-5.3(d)); online courses accepted. In addition, the CE required by the national certifying agency whose examination the APN passed.
rules.carryover: Up to 15 extra contact hours may be carried into the next renewal period (RN rule, N.J.A.C. 13:37-5.3).
rules.alternatives: Inactive status needs no CE (reactivation process required).
rules.audit_note: Board may request certificates (random audit or investigation); keep certificates at least 5 years.

topics.who: All APNs; part of the 30 contact hours (N.J.A.C. 13:37-7.8(b), N.J.S.A. 45:11-47.1)
Required of RNs (APNs hold an RN license): prescription opioids, alternatives, signs of abuse, addiction and diversion

rules.notes: N.J.A.C. 13:37-7.8(a): every biennial period an APN completes the CE required for RN renewal under N.J.A.C. 13:37-5.3 (30 contact hours) plus the CE requirements of the national certifying agency whose examination the APN passed; 2 of the credits must be end-of-life care.
rules.rule_quote: Each licensee must complete a minimum of 30 contact hours of continuing education contact hours during the two-year period preceding renewal.
